title: Status.account uses serde_json::Value instead of Account type
description: mastodon_api.rs:42 defines Status.account as serde_json::Value, but the Account type already exists in profile.rs. This leaks serde_json as a required dependency for callers accessing account data, prevents type-safe field access, and means the compiler cannot catch mismatches between Status.account and the Account struct. Every downstream server must do runtime JSON manipulation instead of struct access.
close_reason: Won't fix: Value is intentional. Servers build account JSON from heterogeneous sources. Doc comment added explaining rationale.
